content.title: About
content.content: Fruit mixture, frozen is a ready‑to‑use blend of diced berries and tropical fruits (strawberry, raspberry, blueberry, pineapple, mango) that are flash‑frozen at low temperature to preserve flavor, aroma and nutrients. The mix is convenient for smoothies, desserts, baking or simply as a refreshing snack.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The blend contains 100 % natural fruit with no added sugar, preservatives or artificial flavors.
IQF (individually quick frozen) technology retains over 90 % of vitamin C and other antioxidants.
The mixture is widely used in professional kitchens to speed up dish preparation.
It is suitable for vegetarians and vegans.
Packaging is usually made from recyclable PET material.

items.title: Rich in vitamin C
items.content: Vitamin C supports the immune system and aids collagen synthesis.

items.title: Antioxidants
items.content: Berries provide anthocyanins and polyphenols that help combat free radicals.

items.title: Dietary fiber
items.content: Fiber promotes healthy digestion and contributes to satiety.

items.title: Potassium
items.content: Potassium helps regulate fluid balance and heart function.

items.title: Low‑calorie snack
items.content: The mix is low in fat and calories, making it suitable for weight‑management diets.

items.title: Allergy to specific fruits
items.content: Some individuals may be allergic to strawberry, mango or pineapple.

items.title: Natural sugar content
items.content: Although no sugar is added, the natural sugars in the fruit can affect blood glucose levels in people with diabetes.

items.title: Improper storage
items.content: If the mixture thaws and refreezes, quality may degrade and microbial risk can increase.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Add the mix to smoothies, yogurt, oatmeal, use it in baked goods (muffins, cakes) or simply thaw and enjoy as a refreshing dessert. For extra sweetness, drizzle with honey or maple syrup.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep in the freezer at –18 °C (0 °F) or lower. After opening, use within 3–4 months. Do not thaw and refreeze to maintain texture and safety.
